item.title: Dr Reddy's receives DCGI approval for esophageal cancer drug Zytorvi
item.description: Dr Reddy's Laboratories on Wednesday said it has received approval from the Drugs Controller General of India (DCGI) for Zytorvi (toripalimab), through which it aims to expand access to first-line immunotherapy for patients with advanced esophageal squamous cell carcinoma (ESCC) in India. The drug has been approved in combination with cisplatin and paclitaxel for the first-line treatment of adult patients with unresectable advanced, recurrent, or metastatic ESCC, the pharma company said in a release. This marks Zytorvi's second approved indication in the country, expanding beyond nasopharyngeal carcinoma. ESCC accounts for approximately 80 per cent of all esophageal cancer cases in India, the company said. Zytorvi contains toripalimab, a monoclonal antibody that binds to PD-1 and blocks its interaction with PD-L1 and PD-L2, thereby supporting T-cell activity against cancer cells. item.title: Piramal Finance Q2FY27 results: Net profit zooms 67% to ₹545 crore

The company's core net interest income grew 35 per cent to Rs 1,530 crore due to a 24 per cent growth in assets under management and a 0.35 per cent expansion in net income margin to 6.5 per cent. The cost-to-income ratio improved sharply to 52.1 per cent during the reporting quarter from 61.2 per cent, helping the bottom line.
